instruction:
Single Zone Office Shoebox

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an OpenStudio 3.10 single-story office shoebox model and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.osm with size at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json with size at least 10 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly one OS:Version object whose version identifier starts with 3.10.
3. /home/user/Desktop/result.osm contains exactly 1 OS:Building, 1 OS:BuildingStory, 1 OS:Space, and 1 OS:ThermalZone.
4. The single OS:Space references the single OS:BuildingStory, references the single OS:ThermalZone, and has Part of Total Floor Area set to Yes.
5. The model has exactly 6 OS:Surface objects: 1 Floor surface, 1 RoofCeiling surface, and 4 Wall surfaces with Outside Boundary Condition set to Outdoors.
6. The surface geometry forms a rectangular box with X span 12.00 m, Y span 8.00 m, and Z span 3.60 m, each with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
7. The floor surface area is 96.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
8. The sum of the 4 exterior wall gross areas is 144.00 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
9. The model has exactly 2 window subsurfaces whose Sub Surface Type is FixedWindow, OperableWindow, GlassDoor, or Skylight.
10. The south facade is the exterior wall with the lowest world-coordinate center Y value, and its total window area is 17.28 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
11. The east facade is the exterior wall with the highest world-coordinate center X value, and its total window area is 11.52 m2 with tolerance +/-0.50 m2.
12. The north facade and west facade have total window area no greater than 0.05 m2 each.
13. The south window-to-wall ratio is 0.40 with tolerance +/-0.03, and the east window-to-wall ratio is 0.40 with tolerance +/-0.03.
14. Each window has minimum vertex Z equal to 0.90 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m.
15. The model contains at least one OS:DefaultConstructionSet and the single OS:Building references a default construction set.
16. The model contains exactly 1 OS:ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem, exactly 1 OS:ZoneHVAC:EquipmentList, and the equipment list references both the single OS:ThermalZone and the ideal loads system.
17. The model contains exactly 1 OS:ThermostatSetpoint:DualSetpoint referenced by the single OS:ThermalZone.
18. The thermostat heating schedule is an OS:Schedule:Constant with value 21.00 C with tolerance +/-0.25 C, and the cooling schedule is an OS:Schedule:Constant with value 24.00 C with tolerance +/-0.25 C.
19. The ideal loads availability schedule is an OS:Schedule:Constant with value 1.
20. /home/user/Desktop/kpis.json contains floor_area_m2, exterior_wall_area_m2, south_window_area_m2, and east_window_area_m2 values matching the evaluator-computed model metrics with tolerance max(0.10, 1%).

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
